ambiguities.text: The documentation does not explicitly specify the memory expansion cost formula.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM memory expansion cost: memory_cost = (memory_size_words^2) / 512 + (3 * memory_size_words). This is the established formula from the Yellow Paper.

ambiguities.text: The buffer_read function uses 'right_pad_zero_bytes' but the exact padding behavior is not detailed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume zero-padding extends the read data to the requested size by appending zero bytes on the right when reading past the buffer end.

ambiguities.text: Maximum memory size limits are not specified in the documentation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume memory is limited by gas costs - quadratic gas cost makes very large memory practically infeasible within block gas limits.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory operations assume sufficient gas has been charged before execution.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Performing memory operations without proper gas accounting could lead to resource exhaustion attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is assumed to be initialized to all zeros at the start of each call context.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uninitialized memory could leak data between call contexts, violating isolation guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: The bytearray implementation is assumed to be memory-safe and not vulnerable to buffer overflows.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Buffer overflow vulnerabilities in memory implementation could allow arbitrary code execution or memory corruption.
